## Checklist

- [ ] Public APIs and behavior are documented.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, personal paths, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated from their owner scripts.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration requirements are explicit.
- [ ] Third-party code includes complete license and attribution information.
